Generator fixtures are original Wyreup test data, authored for these tests and
licensed under the repository MIT license. No competitor content or executable
configuration is loaded. `GeneratorHarness.svelte` imports actual
`textDeveloperTools` from the source under review, never the deliberately
unregistered default registry. Delayed lifecycle tests wrap its real output in a
controlled transport delay/error; they are not generator-engine acceptance for
the artificial failure. Fixed literal robots/CSP/hreflang/nginx strings are
independent expected-output oracles. The 300-row original nginx dataset proves
pagination and full-artifact retention, including an edited row on page two.
Downloaded artifacts are reopened and compared byte for byte. Malicious-looking
HTML is displayed as Svelte text and never executed. Browser tests use an owned
loopback server and Chromium; human/production/npm acceptance is separate.
